name: Rudrabha Chakraborty
headline: AI Engineer | Generative AI, Agentic Systems & LLM Evaluation
summary: AI Engineer with 1.5+ years building production Generative AI for commercial insurance underwriting and claims on Microsoft Azure. Ships agentic RAG assistants, retrieval augmented document extraction, and guideline to rules engines, and treats evaluation as part of the product: regression harnesses, ground truth scoring, and DSPy prompt optimization. Core engineer on an extraction platform running at 95.4% mean field accuracy across 362 live submissions. M.Sc. Computer Science, NIT Trichy.

Backend & Cloud: Azure (OpenAI, Container Apps, Functions, Cosmos DB, Service Bus)

projects.name: LossRuns | Loss Run Extraction Engine
projects.tech: Azure OpenAI, Hybrid Search, FastAPI, Celery, Redis
bullets: Turned carrier loss runs with no shared format into structured claims data by building a retrieval augmented pipeline with hybrid BM25 and dense search and 55+ carrier specific prompt routes, reaching 95.4% mean field accuracy across 15 fields on 362 live submissions, 54 fully zero touch.
Stopped LLM cost from scaling with volume by designing a hybrid line of business classifier: rules and fuzzy matching settle clear claims, and only ambiguous ones go to a batched LLM fallback.

Slimmed the service by moving dense retrieval from local sentence transformers to OpenAI embeddings, removing PyTorch from the image; A/B benchmarked Mistral OCR vs Azure Document Intelligence to drive the OCR vendor choice.

projects.name: CLAIMS | Claims Document Intelligence Platform
projects.tech: DAG Orchestration, Cosmos DB, Service Bus, Azure Document Intelligence
bullets: Solved mixed claim bundles (adjuster reports, estimates, invoices in one PDF) with a multi label page classifier that splits each file into typed sections before extraction.

Cut tenant onboarding from a code release to a config change by extending the DAG orchestration engine with invoice and estimate pipelines and making loss run, property schedule, and ACORD form flows config driven.
Replaced duplicated loss cause logic with one multi tenant LLM classification microservice using a global, app, and tenant config hierarchy, now serving both Claims and Loss Runs.

projects.name: SENSE | AI Underwriting Copilot
projects.tech: Agentic RAG, GPT 5.2, ChromaDB, Qdrant, FastAPI
bullets: Built the planner executor core of an agentic underwriting assistant: Tool RAG over ChromaDB selects tools, the LLM planner emits a structured tool call plan, and response composers ground every answer in retrieved submission data.
Caught conflicting rules before release with LLM contradiction detection over rules extracted from guideline PDFs, backed by versioned rule diffing and governance APIs.
Kept generated insights honest with an XML structured prompt that reasons only over rule engine verdicts, so every insight traces back to a specific rule.

projects.name: Broker Slip Extraction Pipeline (End to End)
projects.tech: DSPy, Prompt Chaining, GPT 5.2, Celery, Azure
bullets: Raised exact match accuracy from 72.3% to 79.9% on a 57 case regression set by decomposing a 19 field prompt carrying 56 negative instructions into focused coverage and peril prompts and removing hallucinated flood and earthquake limits.
Replaced manual prompt tuning with DSPy prompt optimization, using the regression set as the evaluation metric, so prompt changes became measurable and repeatable.

Built an Azure Functions evaluation service that scores model output against human reviewed ground truth daily and emails a weekly accuracy report, plus regression harnesses that gate prompt and model changes across three pipelines.

projects.name: Empathy Aware Conversational AI
bullets: Built a RAG chatbot on LLaMA 2 fine tuned on EmotionLines, improving contextually relevant responses by 20% and empathetic response accuracy by 30%.

projects.name: Retail Sales Forecasting
bullets: Built a Random Forest forecaster on Walmart sales data (WMAE 1528.71 in validation), outperforming KNN and Extra Trees baselines with K Fold cross validation.
